_nameNote: name 决定 NSIS 的 APP_FILENAME（安装目录名）。productName 是中文，过不了 electron-builder 的 ^[-_+0-9a-zA-Z .]+$ 校验，会回落到 sanitizeFileName(name)。所以这里必须是 SnSclaw，否则安装目录会多出一层子目录。
name: SnSclaw
description: SnSclaw AI 助手 — 面向企业级场景的私有化智能体平台，集成多模态模型、知识库检索、语音交互与自动化工具链（HTTP/SSE 运行时）
author: SnSclaw

scripts.setup: npm run setup:jar && npm run setup:jre
scripts.package:mac:local: npm run build && cross-env BUILD_MODE=local electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:mac:remote: npm run build && cross-env BUILD_MODE=remote electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:win:local: npm run build && cross-env BUILD_MODE=local electron-builder --win
scripts.package:win:remote: npm run build && cross-env BUILD_MODE=remote electron-builder --win
